xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex70032024-10-17-14-13" status="unreviewed">gnyis pa 'thad pa rigs pa'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4307">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">gnyal</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4307">gzas pa</rs></note>na re byang chub phyogs dang mthun pa ni 'phags pa'i gang zag bzhi ka'i lam yin te lam po che lta bu'o zhes bsam nas chos dkar po thams cad kyi gzhi'i dngos po byed pa la sogs pa ni 'dun pa la sogs pa grogs kyis byed pa yin pas ldan zhes pa kun la mi sbyar te| sbyar na byang chub sems phyogs mthun pa dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa 'phags pa bzhi ka'i lam yin par thal bas so zhes gsung pa ni ma yin te༔ phyogs mthun dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi lam du gsungs pa dang | grogs la nus pa de dang de yod pas grogs can la de dang de mi khegs pa'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
